Seer.directive_rationale: Continue using early claiming and providing clear data to force wolves into 'logic posturing'.
Seer.actual_player_behavior: Hoang immediately claimed 'I am the Seer' in the first turn of the Round 1 debate and provided investigation data on Nhan.
Seer.verdict_notes: The Seer revealed their role and provided data in Round 1 as directed.

Guard.directive_rationale: Always prioritize the Seer over any other role; the information pipeline is more valuable than any single life.
Guard.actual_player_behavior: In Round 1 night, Nhan protected himself. In Round 2 night, Nhan protected Hoang (the Seer).
Guard.verdict_notes: The Guard failed to protect the Seer in Round 1 (protecting himself instead), but followed the directive in Round 2.

Witch.directive_rationale: In future games, coordinate or diversify targets to avoid redundant resource use with the Guard.
Witch.actual_player_behavior: Cong used the save potion on Hoang in Round 2. However, the Guard (Nhan) also protected Hoang in the same round.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Witch used the save potion on the same target as the Guard, resulting in redundant resource use, which is exactly what the directive aimed to avoid.

Witch.directive_rationale: if the Seer identifies a wolf, poison them immediately to end the threat.
Witch.verdict_notes: The Seer only identified non-wolves (Nhan and Cong) during the game record.

Villager.directive_rationale: When a player... pivots to criticizing communication style, treat it as a primary wolf signal.
Villager.verdict_notes: No player pivoted to criticizing communication style; critiques were focused on lack of logic or mirroring.
No personality-based deflections were observed in the debate.

Villager.directive_rationale: Stick to the Process of Elimination (PoE) map based on Seer data.
Villager.actual_player_behavior: Nam and Jin both explicitly stated that since Nhan and Cong were cleared, the wolf must be among Nam, Jin, and Riley, and proceeded to target Riley based on this narrowed list.
Villager.verdict_notes: The villagers used the Seer's clears to narrow the pool of suspects and isolate the remaining variables.
